# Increased task-related errors for Copilot Mission Control

## What Changed

Nov 4, 10:01 UTC Resolved - This incident has been resolved. Thank you for your patience and understanding as we addressed this issue. A detailed root cause analysis will be shared as soon as it is available. Nov 4, 10:01 UTC Monitoring - The degradation has been mitigated. We are monitoring to ensure stability. Nov 4, 09:50 UTC Update - We're continuing to see recovery as rollout continues Nov 4, 09:11 UTC Update - We've identified the issue with a specific client version and are deploying a mitigation. We are already seeing partial recovery. Nov 4, 08:47 UTC Update - Copilot Mission Control is experiencing increased error rates (approx 2.5%) in listing and creating tasks due to upstream database throttling. We are investigating two potential mitigations. Nov 4, 08:45 UTC Investigating - We are investigating reports of impacted performance for some GitHub services.
